digest.component_or_area: store sync and push union guard
propositions: A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching sync._union_merge must return without merging and preserve both pre-operation refs exactly
A stale clone with mismatched epoch reaching push.py's non-FF retry must return immediately without merging or re-pushing, terminating the retry loop and leaving the push not-completed
The epoch field must be stored in .store-compat.json as a JSON string (ISO-8601 UTC instant plus random suffix), compared only for byte equality, and treated as corrupt if non-string

All nine state-matrix rows (record absent/present and epoch absent/present combinations, plus corrupt/unreadable) must abort or proceed according to the documented matrix, distinguishing remote-ref-unreadable from remote-file-absent in log messages
write_compat_record must preserve an existing valid string epoch, leave pre-epoch records absent, and never generate a new epoch value
After a guard-aborted epoch-mismatch push, fsck must report DIVERGED (not PUSH_PENDING) with local and remote tips unchanged and zero merge invocations
